ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactAdmitComm.description: ArtifactAdmitCommand requests immutable artifact staging and publication metadata admission.

artifact.description: artifact identifies immutable bytes without granting future reads.

declaredLength.description: declared_length bounds the total artifact bytes before allocation or publication.

expectedGeneration.description: expected_generation permits zero for initial creation and otherwise prevents stale publication.

frameCount.description: frame_count bounds independently authenticated frame metadata.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactAdmitComm.title: Artifact Admit Command

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactDeleteCom.description: ArtifactDeleteCommand requests immediate tombstone and subsequent purge work.

artifact.description: artifact identifies the scoped immutable artifact to tombstone.

expectedGeneration.description: expected_generation prevents deletion against an unintended generation.

purgeAfterTombstone.description: purge_after_tombstone requests physical-purge scheduling, not an immediate guarantee.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactDeleteCom.title: Artifact Delete Command

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactReadComma.description: ArtifactReadCommand requests a bounded, authorized range from one artifact generation.

artifact.description: artifact identifies the requested immutable artifact.

generation.description: generation selects a complete immutable generation.

length.description: length is bounded before hydration and must be enforced by the vault.

offset.description: offset is the zero-based byte position.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactReadComma.title: Artifact Read Command

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.description: ArtifactRef identifies an immutable artifact without granting read access.

artifactId.description: artifact_id is an opaque artifact identity.

contentDigest.description: content_digest binds the reference to immutable content.

tenantId.description: tenant_id scopes the artifact identity and prevents cross-tenant reuse.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.title: Artifact Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CapabilityGrant.j.description: CapabilityGrant is an attenuated, expiring grant bound to one execution scope.

actions.description: actions lists exact typed operations; wildcards are invalid at admission.

allowedPaths.description: allowed_paths lists normalized repository-relative path prefixes.

commandFence.description: command_fence binds this grant to one current command-scope fence.

egress.description: egress restricts material permitted to leave the current authority zone.

expiresAt.description: expires_at prevents a grant from becoming standing authority.

grantId.description: grant_id is an opaque grant identity.

initiator.description: initiator is the authenticated principal whose authority was attenuated.

lease.description: lease binds effects to the current fenced execution holder.

nonce.description: nonce prevents cross-request and replay reuse.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest pins the policy evaluated during grant issuance.

repositoryGitOid.description: repository_git_oid pins the permitted source snapshot.

resources.description: resources lists exact tenant-scoped resources; absent resources deny action.

revocationEpoch.description: revocation_epoch invalidates grants after current deny state advances.

taskId.description: task_id scopes the grant to one roster task when applicable.

workflowId.description: workflow_id scopes the grant to one immutable workflow revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CapabilityGrant.j.title: Capability Grant

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.description: CausalContext binds messages to an ordered, fenced causal history.

causationId.description: causation_id names the immediate triggering event or command.

fence.description: fence prevents an expired lease holder from committing.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonically assigned by the canonical ledger.

traceId.description: trace_id identifies a separately authorized trace stream.

watermark.description: watermark records the complete source position observed by a projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.title: Causal Context

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CommandEnvelope.j.description: CommandEnvelope requests a state transition; it is not authorization by itself.

actor.description: actor is the authenticated initiator supplied only by a trusted boundary.

causal.description: causal carries expected sequence, fence, and current watermark.

commandId.description: command_id is a globally unique opaque command identifier.

commandType.description: command_type is a stable, versioned command name.

idempotencyKey.description: idempotency_key is required for state-creating commands.

payloadDigest.description: payload_digest binds the command body held in immutable storage.

submittedAt.description: submitted_at records when the command entered the admission boundary.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CommandEnvelope.j.title: Command Envelope

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EgressManifest.js.description: EgressManifest records the minimum disclosed material and the policy decision.

allowedArtifacts.description: allowed_artifacts is the exact immutable input set permitted to leave.

classification.description: classification records the effective data-classification decision.

destination.description: destination identifies the approved provider, connector, or tool endpoint.

expiresAt.description: expires_at prevents replay after an authorization window closes.

manifestId.description: manifest_id is an opaque manifest identity.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest pins the egress policy and provider/model selection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EgressManifest.js.title: Egress Manifest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ExecuteAuthorityC.description: ExecuteAuthorityCommandRequest carries one bounded typed artifact command.

artifactAdmit.description: artifact_admit is selected for immutable artifact admission.

artifactDelete.description: artifact_delete is selected for tombstone/purge scheduling.

artifactRead.description: artifact_read is selected for bounded artifact hydration.

command.description: command preserves canonical idempotency, actor, causal, and payload-digest framing.

grant.description: grant is rechecked against current policy before any artifact effect.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ExecuteAuthorityC.title: Execute Authority Command Request

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Lease.jsonschema..description: Lease identifies one fenced, expiring owner of a task or scheduled run.

expiresAt.description: expires_at prevents an abandoned holder from remaining authoritative.

fence.description: fence advances when ownership changes and invalidates old holders.

holder.description: holder is the authenticated worker principal.

leaseId.description: lease_id is an opaque lease identifier.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Lease.jsonschema..title: Lease

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ResourceLimit.jso.description: ResourceLimit bounds one measurable resource a grant may consume.

maximum.description: maximum is an inclusive strictly positive ceiling.

name.description: name is a stable resource dimension such as token, wall_time_ms, or bytes.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ResourceLimit.jso.title: Resource Limit

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ToolGrant.jsonsch.description: ToolGrant narrows authority to one certified or quarantined tool package.

allowedOperations.description: allowed_operations lists stable tool operation names.

inputArtifacts.description: input_artifacts lists exact immutable artifact identities allowed as input.

limits.description: limits bounds time, bytes, processes, and other resource dimensions.

toolPackageDigest.description: tool_package_digest pins the exact signed package bytes.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ToolGrant.jsonsch.title: Tool Grant
